text: My 2 year old won't settle tonight. Up and down, wanting cuddles, then wriggling off. Otherwise she's her normal self, playing and chatting. Just so you know, her lips were bright blue earlier but that was a blue raspberry ice lolly her dad gave her after tea. It wiped off with a flannel and they're pink underneath. Mostly wondering if there's anything to help her settle or if I just ride it out.
